form.label: SQL Database Logs - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage dashboard for PostgreSQL connection/error/statement-duration, MySQL and MariaDB error, MySQL slow-query, and MariaDB general-query text-log relay sourcetypes. This is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | stats count

index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ (severity=ERROR OR severity=FATAL OR severity=PANIC OR severity=Warning OR action=error OR action=access_denied) | stats count

index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ action=access_denied | stats count
index=infraops (sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" action=slow_query OR sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" action=statement_duration) host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | stats count

index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | timechart count by sourcetype

index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | eval action_or_severity=coalesce(action,severity,db_command) | stats count by action_or_severity | sort -count | head 20

panel.title: Top database users and client sources

search.query: index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | stats count, values(database) as databases, values(action) as actions, values(severity) as severities by db_user, user, src_ip, src, db_host | sort -count | head 50

index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | eval database_or_command=coalesce(database,db_command,component) | stats count by database_or_command | sort -count | head 20

panel.title: PostgreSQL authentication, errors, and statement durations

search.query: index=infraops sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | table _time host db_user user database process_id severity action query_duration_ms db_statement db_message marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=infraops (sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype thread_id user src_ip severity error_code component action db_message marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | table _time host db_user user db_host src_ip query_time lock_time rows_sent rows_examined action signature marker | sort -_time | head 100
index=infraops sourcetype="mariadb:general:log" host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | table _time host thread_id db_command action db_message marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | stats count, dc(db_user) as db_user_count, dc(src_ip) as source_ip_count, values(vendor_product) as vendor_product by host, source, sourcetype | sort -count | head 100

index=infraops (sourcetype="postgresql:server:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:error:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:error:log" OR sourcetype="mysql:slowquery:log" OR sourcetype="mariadb:general:log") host=$host_tok$ db_user=$db_user_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype vendor product db_user user database src_ip db_command severity action query_duration_ms db_statement signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100
